mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 69 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies with a First Quarter moon. Astronomers take note, the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning starting at 4:10 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching almost directly overhead. The overnight low will be 61 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has two big updates. First, the Department of Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects until September 20. Additionally, the council recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover rising maintenance costs, which will result in an average quarterly increase of about 26 dollars for local homes.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, we have a Girls Try Hockey event this Saturday at the Verona Ice Arena.

On Friday, August 15, Verona police responded to a report of a driver swerving near North Main Street and Cross Country Road. The operator was found passed out behind the wheel and was subsequently arrested for an O W I.

Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Since the store is closing in less than 60 minutes, you will want to head out soon to enjoy it. If you miss out tonight, they open tomorrow morning to serve up Raspberry Cheesecake.
